name: adapt-grow-quote-block
summary: Static quotation card: an optional context line, the quote in italic, and an attribution (name, role, source), with a brand accent bar down the left edge.

fill.note: Tokenised in this batch from a hardcoded Cardiff-Met palette. Mapping by meaning: card surface -> --surface-1, quote and name ink -> --ink, context/attribution meta -> --ink-soft, card shadow -> --shadow, and the brand red accent bar (@grow-red #C8102E) -> --accent as the house brand stripe. Theme supplies the :root token values and dark mode.
